description: Step 4 of the booking guide (get_booking_guide). Ask to book a time with Patrick Vieira for a person: returns a confirm_url to give them. Nothing is reserved yet, and nothing is emailed: the call is booked, in their name, when they open the link and sign in with Google (within 60 minutes). Don't send their name or email address: those come from their sign-in. Only use this when the person has asked for this meeting at this time. Do not retry on error. Then use get_booking_status. Privacy: until the person signs in, the site keeps only the type, time and note; see https://patrickjv.com/privacy.

note.description: Optional: what the meeting is about, in plain text.

start.description: Start time exactly as given by get_availability (ISO 8601 with offset).

type.description: A meeting type id from list_meeting_types.

name: book_meeting
title: Book a meeting
